data.one_liner: A customizable password input widget with validation rules and strength indicator.
data.what_it_does: Provides a password field that can enforce custom validation rules and display a strength meter. It offers built‑in common rules and allows developers to add their own. The widget is fully customizable via builder callbacks.
use_when: You need a password field with built‑in validation and strength feedback
You want to define custom password rules or customize the UI of the indicator
avoid_when: Your app still uses Flutter's default material widgets (package:flutter/material.dart)
You target Flutter versions older than 3.44 or cannot add material_ui
strengths: Highly customizable UI via builder callbacks
Includes a set of ready‑made validation rules and strength calculation
weaknesses: Requires migration to the material_ui package, breaking existing imports
Only works with Flutter ≥3.44 and Dart ≥3.12
Adds an extra dependency (material_ui) to the project
data.setup_notes: Add material_ui to pubspec, import material_ui instead of flutter/material.dart, ensure Flutter ≥3.44.0 and Dart ≥3.12.0
